Garden classification: 3

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

A patient has a complete intracapsular femoral neck fracture with partial displacement. Some relationship between the fragments remains, distinguishing it from total displacement. Which Garden grade best characterizes this fracture before reduction?

  1. Extracapsular intertrochanteric fracture
  2. Garden III
  3. Garden I
  4. Garden II
  5. Garden IV
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

Garden III

A complete femoral neck fracture with partial displacement is Garden III.

Understanding the options

Garden III
A complete femoral neck fracture with partial displacement is Garden III.
Garden I
An incomplete, often valgus-impacted femoral neck fracture is Garden I. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Garden II
A complete but nondisplaced femoral neck fracture is Garden II. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Garden IV
A completely displaced femoral neck fracture is Garden IV. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Extracapsular intertrochanteric fracture
An intertrochanteric fracture is outside the Garden femoral-neck classification. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
